findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_ticker" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Market snapshot: crypto top 5, AI stocks, and metrics, with the snapshot timestamp." → after: "Market snapshot: crypto top 5, SI stocks, and metrics, with the snapshot timestamp."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
